text:
Type: small medallion area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area or entry, softening floors; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, bohemian, classic
Materials: low flat woven pile, printed pattern
Colors: warm brick red, steel blue, cream, dark navy accents
Shape: rectangular, all-over repeating floral medallion lattice, wide blue patterned border, thin flat profile, compact
Feel: warm, rich, inviting, timeless
Goes with: light or rustic wood, white walls, brick or stone floors; traditional, farmhouse or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Medallion-Patterned Rug, 4' x 6', Red and Steel Blue
product.description: This transitional rug boasts a multicolored pattern with a handstitched binding that adds elegance to any room. The soft, thick pile gives it a luxurious feel, great for tired feet. Durable nylon helps prevent wear and tear, keeping the rug looking beautiful. 4'W X 6'L Pile: 100% nylon; back: 100% cotton This durable nylon rug has a handstitched edging. A thick pile gives this rug a luxurious feel. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
